highlights: For the second quarter, Divi's Laboratories reported consolidated total income of ₹3,770 crores compared to ₹2,860 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year, representing a year-on-year growth…
Profit before tax increased to ₹1,505 crores from ₹912 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, reflecting a growth of 65%.
Profit after tax stood at ₹1,127 crores compared to ₹689 crores in the previous year, registering a growth of approximately 64%.
For the first half of FY 2026-2027, consolidated total income stood at ₹6,907 crores compared to ₹5,389 crores in the corresponding period of the previous financial year.

Profit before tax for the half year increased to ₹2,685 crores from ₹1,645 crores, while profit after tax rose to ₹2,029 crores from ₹1,234 crores in the corresponding period last year, with 64% increase.

strengths: Looking at revenue composition and business performance, exports continue to constitute approximately 90% of standalone sales revenue, reflecting the Company's strong international business presence.
Our global nutraceutical business recorded revenue of ₹571 crores for the first half compared to ₹492 crores in the corresponding period of the previous financial year.
With respect to foreign exchange movement, the Company recorded a net forex gain of ₹20 crores during the first half compared to a gain of ₹103 crores in the corresponding period last year.
weaknesses: If I were to look at PBT has grown 50%, 60% first half, but your cash flow from operations ahead of paying taxes has declined 50%, ₹959 crores for the first half of this year.
